features.title: Everything your growth team needs to find the leak

items.title: See conversion drop-off the moment it happens
items.description: Track every step from first visit to activation with funnels that update live, so you catch a broken checkout flow in minutes, not at the end of the quarter.

items.title: Understand which cohorts actually stick
items.description: Segment users by signup week, plan or acquisition channel and compare retention curves side by side to see what is really driving long-term usage.

items.title: Let Pulsegrid explain the why for you
items.description: Our insight engine scans your funnels and cohorts overnight and surfaces the changes most likely to move your activation rate, written in plain English.
